title: useMapState Hook
description:
Implement a `useMapState` hook that stores key/value pairs and returns `{ map, set, get, remove, has, clear }`. The `map` value is a plain object. `set(key, value)` upserts. `remove(key)` deletes. `has(key)` returns a boolean. `get(key)` returns the value.

**Example:**
```tsx
const { map, set, get, remove, has, clear } = useMapState({});
```
ai_context: Common mistake: mutating the map object directly with map[key] = value instead of spreading into a new object — React compares by reference, so a mutation won't trigger a re-render.
